name: Shugoshin no sumu chi -Ein Weltende-
source:
Here is the English translation of the text in the image:

When I came to, I was lying on the ground.
Where am I?
What have I been doing up until now?

"I don't understand.
Why I am
living in this town, I have no idea——"

I ended up living in a town I had never seen before.
What awaited me there was
an ordinary, peaceful everyday life, strange relationships with people,
and forgotten memories——.
translation:
回过神来时，我正倒在地上。
这里是哪里？
此前我究竟在做些什么？

“我不明白。
为什么我会生活在这座小镇上，
我一点头绪也没有——”

就这样，我在一座素未谋面的小镇上开始了生活。
在那里等待着我的，
是平淡安稳的日常、与人们之间奇妙的关系，
以及被遗忘的记忆——
